intro: Academic advisors spend 59 percent of their day on administrative tasks like documentation and scheduling. Using Zoom for academic advisors on Mac does not have to be another source of stress.

blocks.text: Managing Zoom meetings as an academic advisor

When you meet with students, your attention should be on their academic path, not on Zoom settings. Many advisors struggle with audio configuration or finding the right meeting controls during a call. On your Mac, you can use the built in Zoom settings to ensure your environment is ready before the student arrives. Always check your microphone and camera input in Zoom > Settings > Audio and Video before your first session of the day.
Efficiency tips for Mac based advising

items: Use ⌘ ⇧ M to toggle your microphone quickly if you need to check a record in your student information system.
Keep your student notes in a separate app like Obsidian or Notion and use ⌃ ⌘ F to enter full screen mode so you can focus.
Set up a recurring Zoom meeting link for your office hours to avoid generating new invites for every student.
Use the native macOS Split View by hovering over the green button in the top left of any window to keep your Zoom call on one side and your advising dashboard on the other.

blocks.text: Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac and helps you handle tasks without leaving your workflow. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen. If you are stuck in a complex Zoom menu, ask Lazur to point out where the waiting room settings are. You can also ask Lazur to draft a summary of your meeting notes while you are still on the call, which helps you stay organized for your next student.
Common Zoom mistakes in an academic setting

A common mistake is failing to set up a waiting room. This can lead to students accidentally joining a session while you are still talking to someone else. Go to the security icon in your meeting controls to enable the waiting room. Another issue is forgetting to share your computer sound when showing a student a video about degree requirements. Use the share screen menu to toggle this option before you hit play.

Advisors often report that they want to spend 50 percent less time on transactional tasks. You can use text expansion tools or Lazur dictation to speed up your email follow ups. When you finish a meeting, hold fn to dictate your notes directly into your student information system. Keep your notes concise and factual to save time for your next appointment.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Zoom for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps for you. It points at things and guides you through steps so you can perform the actions yourself.

faq.question: How do I ensure my Zoom meetings are secure for students?
faq.answer: Always use the waiting room feature, require a passcode for meetings, and ensure you are running the latest version of the Zoom desktop client.
